title: Molest
summary: MOLEST', verb transitive [Latin molestus, troublesome, molo. See Mill.] To trouble; to disturb; to render uneasy. They have molested the church with needless opposition.

inlines.v: MOLEST', verb transitive [Latin molestus, troublesome, molo. See Mill.] To trouble; to disturb; to render uneasy. They have molested the church with needless opposition.
